_doc: Barbed Wire (defender pool; research/gadgets.md §4.1). Two each; laid on the floor in front of the placer, picked up again. How long it takes to lay, its reach and its size are placeholders. In it (M3): attackers move at half speed and can't sprint (Y3S2.2), drones a little slower ("minimally": ours 90 %), defenders not at all; an attacker moving in it takes 5 every second (Y9S2's New Blood page). Its box is 2.5 m across (Fandom's 1.25 m radius). Two knife hits from either side destroy it; bullets don't (Fandom).
name: Barbed Wire
